per_article_summaries: Former Formula 1 driver David Coulthard has criticised the safety car process. Coulthard backed a proposal to mandate automatic red flags for incidents within the final 10 laps of a race. The safety car was deployed at Silverstone when Max Verstappen became beached at Stowe corner on lap 48 of 52.

Will Buxton believes Isack Hadjar is the most competitive team-mate Max Verstappen has faced since Daniel Ricciardo. Buxton believes Red Bull are once again grappling with an overabundance of drivers for its four available grid slots at Red Bull and sister team, Racing Bulls.

Anthony Davidson defended the decision to finish the British Grand Prix under safety car conditions. The safety car was deployed on lap 48 of 52 when Max Verstappen became beached in the gravel at Stowe corner. The FIA later confirmed that the message was displayed in error, and there were not enough laps left in the race to carry out the full unlapping procedure.

Kimi Antonelli leads the Formula 1 drivers' standings by 25 points from George Russell. The Italian suffered a broken wheel shield in the closing stages of the Silverstone race. Russell finished second in the British Grand Prix to cut the gap to 18 points.

Dudley appeared on the Nu Silver Arrows Radio Show alongside Russell, Mercedes deputy team principal Bradley Lord and trackside engineering director Andrew Shovlin. Russell finished second at his home grand prix at Silverstone after suffering a slow puncture but later capitalising on the late-race safety car.

Max Verstappen's future has been the subject of intense speculation. The Red Bull driver has been linked with a move to Mercedes or McLaren. Former Haas team principal Guenther Steiner has questioned why Mercedes would attempt to sign four-time champion Verstappen. Steiner suggested that team boss Toto Wolff is "too smart" to make such a move.

Audi boss Mattia Binotto has set a target of competing for the Formula 1 championship by 2030. The German marque took Sauber’s spot on the F1 grid for 2026. Nine rounds into the campaign it is ninth in the standings with six points.

The 2025 Formula 1 champion is a huge fan of the nine-time MotoGP world champion. The pair appeared together at the Goodwood Festival of Speed on Friday. Norris was on driving duties earlier in the day, taking several machines up the Goodwood hill.

2025 Formula 1 champion Lando Norris took to the iconic Goodwood House balcony during the Festival of Speed. Norris claimed his first championship title at the 2025 Abu Dhabi Grand Prix. McLaren team principal Andrea Stella stressed that the Woking outfit remains focused on the remainder of the 2026 season.
